title: Full Stack Developer (Java/Angular)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Developer (Java/Angular) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo.

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Vaga: Full Stack Developer (Java/Angular)


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica com 30% de coparticipação
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projetos desafiadores com foco no desenvolvimento de soluções robustas e escaláveis, utilizando Java 11+ e frameworks modernos como Spring Boot ou Quarkus. Você participará de todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software – desde a modelagem de dados relacionais até a implementação de testes automatizados, integração com sistemas de mensageria (IBM MQ, Kafka ou RabbitMQ) e práticas de DevOps (CI/CD, pipelines e containers). Além disso, trabalhará em equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a arquitetura de microsserviços e garantindo qualidade, performance e manutenibilidade do código.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio dos conhecimentos essenciais listados abaixo.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara para explicar soluções complexas de forma acessível.
  • Pensamento crítico, proatividade, colaboração e adaptabilidade a novas tecnologias e contextos.


Conhecimentos Essenciais:

  • Linguagem: Java 11+
  • Frameworks: Spring Boot ou Quarkus (com domínio de boas práticas e padrões de projeto)
  • Front-end: Angular 14+
  • Testes: JUnit, Mockito, Karma, Jasmine
  • Banco de Dados: SQL avançado (otimização de consultas, índices e análise de planos de execução)
  • Controle de versão: Git
  • Mensageria: IBM MQ, Kafka ou RabbitMQ
  • Modelagem de dados: bases relacionais
  • DevOps: ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD, pipelines e containers


Conhecimentos Desejados (Diferenciais):

  • Arquitetura: CQRS, Event Sourcing
  • Acessibilidade (WCAG e boas práticas)
  • Fluxo de trabalho Git Flow e GitHub Actions
  • Busca e indexação: Apache Solr ou ElasticSearch
  • Experiência com microsserviços e escalabilidade


Soft Skills:

  • Comunicação clara
  • Pensamento crítico
  • Colaboração
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade


Se você acha que possui 75% ou até 90% do que estamos procurando e sabe que é capaz das responsabilidades e deveres desta função, encorajamos você a se candidatar! Isso mostrará sua disposição a se desenvolver, curiosidade para aprender e crescer profissional e pessoalmente.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.

Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Analista de sistema
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de sistema em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver, manter e analisar aplicações em C e C++ com foco em performance e estabilidade.

Realizar troubleshooting avançado em aplicações, sistemas operacionais e integrações.

Atuar na análise de logs, identificação de falhas e definição de causa raiz.

Diferenciais:

Vivência em ambientes distribuídos e de alta criticidade.

Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Estágio de Direito - Home Office
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Estágio de Direito - Home Office em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O escritório Ulisses Carneiro Advogados  ( especializado em Direito Previdenciário (RGPS) , com sede em Brasília e atuação em todo o território nacional, está com vaga aberta para Estágio em Direito  (6º ao 9º semestre), com atuação 100% home office .

Sobre o Escritório

Com mais de 17 anos de experiência  e 50 mil clientes atendidos em todo o Brasil , o escritório Ulisses Carneiro Advogados se consolidou como referência em Direito Previdenciário.

Somos também pioneiros no uso de tecnologia na advocacia: contamos com o ADV Space , nosso próprio software jurídico integrado com inteligência artificial, criado para otimizar atendimentos e transformar a experiência do cliente.

Nosso fundador, Bruno Ulisses Carneiro, começou a programar em 1998, aos 14 anos, e desde então une Direito e tecnologia para criar soluções inovadoras. Além de advogado, Bruno é professor do Instituto Professora Melissa Folmann , onde já formou centenas de advogados e mentorou profissionais que hoje lideram seus próprios escritórios.


Aqui, o estágio não é apenas cumprir horas: é uma oportunidade de aprender na prática  com quem já formou talentos e continua transformando a advocacia com inovação.

Detalhes da Vaga

  • Horário:  9h às 15h (6 horas diárias)
  • Bolsa:  R$ 1.200,00 + ajuda de custo para home office
  • Modelo:  100% remoto (aceitamos candidatos de qualquer localidade)
  • Início:  imediato, após formalização do contrato pelo IEL


✅ O que esperamos de você

  • Estar cursando entre o 6º e o 9º semestre de Direito .
  • Ter vivência prática em Direito Previdenciário  (estágio anterior, núcleo de prática ou projetos reais).
  • Boa comunicação escrita e/ou oral (recepção de clientes, análise de casos, auxílio em conversão de contratos).
  • Comprometimento, organização e vontade de crescer.

title: Senior Developer in Spyglass
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Developer in Spyglass em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Developer with primary focus on Spyglass Event Configuration Management


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events;
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1/L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape
  • Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELKFalcon LogScale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Thresholdbased and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths, eg OrdertoCash, Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools, eg ServiceNow, based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global AzureGCP backbone


Senior Developer Specifics

  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in eventdriven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct PostMortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Must have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level, proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor, GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration
  • Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization, Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON, XML, Syslog

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Financial Analyst em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de processos sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: AI Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Development Orchestrator em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: CEO

Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git

Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users

Start: Immediate


The Company

Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.


The Role

You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems; the agents think in code.

Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem; the strongest output is selected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.


What You Do

  • Review every AI-generated commit. Not \"does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\"
  • Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear.
  • Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage.
  • Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent.
  • Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix.
  • Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.


Must-Haves

  • Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer; the AI is the author.
  • Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant.
  • TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems.
  • React in production. Next.js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns.
  • Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it.
  • Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down.
  • Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations.
  • Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.


Strong Signals

  • Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison.
  • Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code).
  • Database-level access control in production.
  • Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling.
  • OWASP Top 10 fluency.
  • Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.


Red Flags

  • AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you.
  • Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance.
  • Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify.
  • Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review.
  • Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack.
  • Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership.
  • No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.


Who This Person Is

3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant.

You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.


How We Evaluate

No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing.

  • Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom?
  • Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything.
  • Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output?
  • AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.


What We Offer

  • A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access.
  • The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory.
  • Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately.
  • A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only.
  • A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI; quality comes from you.


To Apply or Refer

Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

description:

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in LATAM currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities:


FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on LATAM markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization.
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including:

  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.


Requirements

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.

Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: LATAM (BRL, MXN, ARS)

Experience working at:

  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks

Hands-on experience building or optimizing:

  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.

Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments.
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

En VMetrix não buscamos fazer “mais barulho”, mas construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:

About the Role

We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in WordPress and HubSpot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.


This is not a classic WordPress role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern JavaScript and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.


If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,

brittle WordPress builds, you'll fit right in.


Key Responsibilities

Website Development

  • Design and build production-grade marketing websites in WordPress (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and HubSpot CMS (HubL templating, modules, themes).
  • Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate
  • prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.
  • Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).
  • Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.


API Integrations & Automation Hooks

  • Integrate websites with HubSpot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.
  • Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.
  • Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).


Quality, Performance & SEO

  • Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.
  • Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, HubSpot tracking, server-side events where needed).
  • Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.


Collaboration

  • Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.
  • Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/GitHub), and documentation.
  • Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.


Required Skills

Technical

  • 3+ years building production websites in WordPress (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).
  • Strong HubSpot CMS experience (HubL, modules, themes, forms, smart content).
  • Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.
  • Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.
  • Comfortable in Git/GitHub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.


Modern Web Skills

  • Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).
  • Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).
  • Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).
  • Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).


Bonus Experience

(Not required, but highly valuable)

  • Webflow development experience.
  • Headless WordPress or HubSpot setups (Next.js + WP/HubSpot APIs).
  • Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.
  • Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.
  • E-commerce experience (WooCommerce, Shopify).
  • Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.


Soft Skills

  • Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.
  • Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.
  • Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.
  • Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.
  • Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.


What Success Looks Like

  • In the first 60–90 days, you will:
  • Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.
  • Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).
  • Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (HubSpot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.
  • Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About LINES


LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.


We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.



What you'll do


  • Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style)
  • Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization
  • Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients
  • Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability
  • Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency
  • Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database
  • Design data models for high-write, real-time systems
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction
  • Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows
  • Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower



What we expect


  • Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset
  • Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization
  • Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs
  • Designs for scale even when the system is still small
  • Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it
  • Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar
  • Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency
  • Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering
  • Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities
  • Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast
  • Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality



Tech stack


  • Backend: NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript
  • Infra: AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare
  • Data: Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)
  • Frontend: Next.js, Expo (React Native)
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions



Nice to have


  • Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces
  • Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience
  • Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration)
  • Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video)
  • React Native or Expo

﻿

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista em Infraestrutura Azure em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?



O Customer Success Architect (CSA) – Infraestrutura do Azure (Armazenamento, Arquivos, Rede) é responsável por orientar os clientes no desenho, na implantação, na operação e na otimização de soluções de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking. Essa função atua como um(a) consultor(a) técnico(a) de confiança, garantindo que os clientes alcancem resultados de negócio e técnicos por meio de uma infraestrutura de nuvem segura, escalável, resiliente e bem governada, alinhada às melhores práticas da Microsoft e ao Cloud Adoption Framework.



✅ Competências e conhecimentos técnicos essenciais

Azure Storage – Fundamentos e arquitetura

• Arquitetura de contas do Azure Storage e considerações de design

• Serviços de armazenamento: Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Disks, Queue Storage e Table Storage

• Camadas de desempenho e opções de redundância (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS)

• Planejamento de capacidade, escalabilidade e otimização de custos

• Gerenciamento do ciclo de vida dos dados e estratégias de tiering

Azure Files

• Arquitetura do Azure Files e protocolos suportados (SMB, NFS)

• Integração de identidade com Azure AD e Active Directory

• Camadas de desempenho de compartilhamentos de arquivos e casos de uso

• Cenários de migração a partir de servidores de arquivos on-premises

• Alta disponibilidade, snapshots e integração com backup

Azure Networking – Conceitos principais

• Virtual Networks (VNets), sub-redes e endereçamento IP

• Segurança de rede com NSGs e Azure Firewall

• Padrões de conectividade: VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute

• Private Endpoints e service endpoints

• Conceitos de DNS e resolução de nomes no Azure

✅ Monitoramento, observabilidade e operações

• Monitoramento de componentes de Azure Storage, Azure Files e Azure Networking

• Integração com Azure Monitor e Azure Network Watcher

• Métricas de taxa de transferência, latência, disponibilidade e erros

• Monitoramento de contas de armazenamento, compartilhamentos de arquivos e recursos de rede

Logs e análises

• Integração com Log Analytics Workspace

• Análise de logs e métricas usando Kusto Query Language (KQL)

• Criação de Workbooks e dashboards para visibilidade da infraestrutura

• Monitoramento proativo e insights operacionais

✅ Backup, recuperação e resiliência

Proteção de dados e continuidade de negócios

• Conceitos de backup e recuperação para Azure Storage e Azure Files

• Integração com Azure Backup e Recovery Services Vault

• Estratégias de snapshot e validação de restauração

• Requisitos de retenção de dados e conformidade

Alta disponibilidade e recuperação de desastres

• Redundância de armazenamento e arquiteturas com consciência de zona (zone-aware)

• Resiliência de rede e redundância de conectividade

• Cenários de DR entre regiões (cross-region) e híbridos

• Monitoramento de desempenho, capacidade e saúde

✅ Segurança, governança e conformidade

• Melhores práticas de segurança para Azure Storage e Azure Networking

• Criptografia em repouso e em trânsito

• Identidade, controle de acesso e desenho de RBAC

• Governança com Azure Policy e estratégias de tags

• Proteção contra exfiltração de dados e configurações incorretas


Automação e integração (desejável):

• Automação usando PowerShell, Azure CLI ou ARM/Bicep

• Integração com Azure Automation e Logic Apps

• Práticas de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC)

• Runbooks operacionais padronizados

✅ Responsabilidades de Engajamento e Entrega ao Cliente

• Atuar como consultor de confiança para clientes corporativos e de missão crítica

• Projetar e validar arquiteturas de armazenamento e rede do Azure

• Liderar workshops técnicos e revisões de arquitetura

• Apoiar as fases de integração, adoção e otimização

• Solucionar problemas em cenários complexos de armazenamento e rede

• Colaborar com Gerentes de Contas do Cliente (CSAMs), equipes de entrega e parceiros

✅ Perfil de Experiência

• Experiência em projetar e operar soluções de infraestrutura do Azure

• Experiência prática com Azure Storage, Azure Files e Redes

• Experiência com cargas de trabalho de escala empresarial ou de missão crítica

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de governança e monitoramento do Azure

• Fortes habilidades de solução de problemas e relacionamento com o cliente



Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens esporádicas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas.   • Reliable forecasting and structured market reporting.
  • LATAM positioned as a scalable and repeatable growth region.

description:

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Machine Learning Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next‑generation AI‑native B2B platform for hospitality. We’re looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who is excited about the craft of machine learning—especially the mathematical and statistical foundations behind models—and who can turn that depth into solutions that scale in real-world use. If you’re someone who enjoys choosing the right model for the problem, validating it rigorously, and improving it through iteration, you’ll feel at home here.


This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to grow into a future architect , help define large-scale backend systems, and become a true technical champion within the team. If you are passionate about modern backend engineering, clean architecture, and scalable distributed systems, you’ll love working with us.


What you’ll do

  • Design, train, and improve statistical and machine learning models for real product use cases.
  • Apply strong fundamentals in probability, statistics, and modeling to make sound decisions on approach and evaluation.
  • Build scalable ML solutions that can be used reliably in production environments.
  • Develop capabilities to support agent-like experiences within our platform (e.g., intelligent workflows, tool-using behaviors, retrieval patterns, guardrails).
  • Define and monitor meaningful model metrics, run error analysis, and iterate based on results.


What we’re looking for

We’re intentionally not treating this as a checklist. If you’re strong in the fundamentals and have built real ML systems, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have :

  • Strong knowledge across a broad range of machine learning algorithms (supervised/unsupervised methods, ensembles, linear models, tree-based methods, deep learning basics) and the judgment to choose appropriately.
  • Solid grounding in statistics and mathematical reasoning (e.g., bias/variance tradeoffs, uncertainty, evaluation design).
  • Experience building ML solutions in practice: data understanding, feature design, training, evaluation, and iteration.
  • Strong Python skills and the ability to write clear, maintainable code.
  • Familiarity with standard ML tooling (e.g., scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow).

Nice to have (not required)

  • Experience with NLP and/or LLMs (helpful, but not a core requirement).
  • Exposure to ML-related capabilities on AWS , such as training/inference workflows or managed ML services (e.g., SageMaker), and working with storage/data access patterns commonly used for ML.
  • Experience implementing or integrating vector search / embedding-based retrieval .


Why Join Us

You will work in a modern, AI-native engineering culture building applied machine learning systems that ship. You’ll have the opportunity to design mathematically grounded models, turn them into scalable product capabilities, and help define how intelligent agents live inside our platform. This role is ideal for someone who loves ML fundamentals, enjoys solving real problems end-to-end, and wants to grow into a senior technical leader shaping our ML direction.

title: Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Paid Ads QA Auditor - Global em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you obsessive about catching what others miss?


Do you notice inconsistencies without being told where to look?


Do you get satisfaction from identifying errors before they become problems?


Final question: when faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away?


If that sounds like you, you may be the perfect fit for our Paid Ads QA role.


At Crisp, we're on a mission to help 10,000 law firms each grow their revenue by $10,000,000 over the next 10 years, creating a $10 billion impact in the legal industry.


Our Paid Ads team is responsible for executing paid media campaigns that power our law firm clients’ brand awareness and growth across major digital platforms. These campaigns are deployed across hundreds of client accounts and multiple platforms simultaneously.


This role exists to ensure those campaigns are executed accurately, consistently, and in alignment with internal standards and client intent.


This is a non-client-facing, audit-focused role that requires extreme attention to detail, strong system thinking, and the discipline to identify and document discrepancies with zero tolerance for preventable error.


However, it is not a “task-ing” role, or a role where you’ll be constantly told what to do - you’ll be expected to self-sufficiently spot and correct errors, but most importantly, get ahead of them before even happening, including improving existing systems.


** IMPORTANT: TO APPLY **

You will be evaluated and vetted based on your ability to follow instructions:

Follow this Willo link (recorded interview platform), and answer the few questions on there, first.Then reply to the ad, stating you’ve completed the Willo, and we will be in touch.


Key Responsibilities Include:


Campaign Audit & Validation

  • Audit paid advertising campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, , TikTok, streaming platforms, and others
  • Verify that the correct creative assets, ad copy, and campaign structures are deployed on the correct client accounts
  • Ensure campaigns align with intended funnel stages and approved execution parameters


Execution Accuracy & Cross-Account Integrity

  • Identify discrepancies such as:
  • Incorrect assets deployed to the wrong client
  • Mismatched ad copy or campaign configurations
  • Inconsistent implementation across platforms
  • Ensure campaign execution matches internal direction and client-specific setup


Budget & Pacing Verification

  • Audit campaign budgets to ensure alignment with approved allocations
  • Identify risks of underdelivery or overspend
  • Validate that budget adjustments and reallocations are executed correctly


Tracking, Links & Technical QA

  • Verify accuracy and functionality of:
  • URLs and landing pages
  • UTM parameters and tracking links
  • Pixel and tag implementation (where applicable)
  • Identify gaps in tracking integrity and flag inconsistencies


Instruction Fidelity & Change Validation

  • Compare campaign execution against:
  • Internal strategy direction
  • Client Success Manager requests
  • Campaign updates or pivots
  • Ensure requested changes are implemented accurately and completely


Audit Documentation & Communication

  • Document audit findings clearly, with supporting context and evidence
  • Categorize issues based on severity (e.g., minor discrepancy vs. critical error)
  • Communicate findings in a structured format that enables efficient resolution


Audit Operations (Evolving Scope)


This role may operate across a range of audit models depending on business needs, including:

Audit Cadence:

  • Pre-launch validation
  • Post-launch verification
  • Ongoing daily, weekly, or periodic audits

Audit Coverage:

  • Full account audits
  • Targeted sampling across accounts

Audit Depth:

  • Surface-level validation (assets, placements, links)
  • Deeper audits (budget pacing, tracking, structural accuracy)

Ownership Scope:

  • Identifying and flagging discrepancies
  • Recommending corrective actions
  • Supporting enforcement of quality standards


Our requirements are pretty straightforward. To qualify you must:

  • Be highly detail-oriented — you catch inconsistencies others miss
  • Think in structured processes, checklists, and systems
  • Be proactive in identifying issues and asking clarifying questions
  • Be comfortable operating with incomplete information and making sound judgments
  • Have strong written communication skills
  • Be tech-savvy and able to learn new platforms quickly
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment


Preferred Experience:

  • Experience auditing or QA-ing digital campaigns (launches, changes, tracking)
  • Familiarity with UTM structures, tracking links, and link verification
  • Experience working with dashboards or reporting tools
  • Experience using project management or task tracking tools (Asana, Monday, etc.)


Nice to Have:

  • Salesforce or CRM familiarity
  • Experience with Supermetrics or similar data connectors
  • Familiarity with Google Looker Studio or similar dashboards
  • Experience documenting processes or building SOPs
  • Experience in a fast-paced, multi-client environment


Platform Exposure (Preferred, Not Required):

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Ads
  • Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • TikTok Ads
  • Ads
  • TradeDesk


Why Our Work Matters:


Lawyers go to law school to learn how to practice law, but law school doesn’t teach them how to run a business. In a world where the best cases often go to the best marketers, legal expertise alone isn’t enough.


That’s where Crisp comes in.


We partner with committed, growth-minded law firms that care deeply about their teams, clients, and communities. Often, it’s a David vs. Goliath scenario, where the most dedicated attorneys lack the resources of their larger competitors.


Our work levels the playing field by giving law firms access to world-class marketing execution that helps them stand out, build authority, and grow sustainably.


About Crisp:

Crisp has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 (Fastest Growing Private Companies in the U.S. – 2024, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017), as well as Atlanta's Top 100 Fastest Growing Private Companies (2025, 2024, 2023, 2022, 2021, 2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016) and Atlanta's Best Places to Work (2024, 2023, 2022).


Crisp ( is the nation’s fastest-growing law firm growth company. We’ve helped thousands of attorneys — from solo and small firms to large practices — build their brand, differentiate themselves from competitors, attract better cases, and earn millions in new revenue.

Crisp has been featured in Forbes, Inc., Avvo, ABA Journal, The Trial Lawyer, Huffington Post, and The Wall Street Journal.


OUR BOOK:

The Game Changing Attorney (available on Amazon and Barnes & Noble)


OUR PODCAST:

The Game Changing Attorney Podcast


Why You Should Work Here:

  • You will work inside a structured, high-performance marketing operation
  • You will contribute to campaigns running at scale across hundreds of accounts
  • You will play a direct role in improving execution accuracy and system reliability
  • You will be trusted to identify and surface critical issues


This is not a role for someone looking for easy work or vague expectations.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in enforcing standards, identifying errors, and ensuring systems operate correctly.

  • Deep understanding of data modeling and database schema design for both relational and non-relational systems
  • Hands-on experience with data infrastructure tooling, including orchestration, storage, and warehousing
  • Solid command of asynchronous programming and distributed systems concepts
  • Experience building and integrating RESTful APIs
  • Comfort operating in small, fast-moving teams with limited oversight
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive mindset


Bonus points for:

  • Familiarity with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Previous work supporting ML, AI, or agentic systems

Benefits:

  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.

title: Creative Producer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Creative Producer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

VOA Creative Producer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Contract

Company: Pocket FM



About Us

At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. With a global audience of over 200 million listeners, we are redefining entertainment through episodic audio storytelling across diverse genres. We are seeking a highly organized and creative Creative Producer to manage and oversee the end-to-end production of high-quality audio content.

Role Overview

As a Creative Producer , you will play a key role in managing the end-to-end production process of audio content across various formats on Pocket FM. You will collaborate closely with writers, voice artists, creators, and production teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality episodes. The role requires strong operational management, creative oversight, and the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling audio experiences for our listeners.



Key Responsibilities

1. Content Operations Management

Ensure smooth daily operations of running audio shows and manage the production pipeline to deliver episodes as per planned schedules.

2. Creator & Talent Coordination

Work closely with voice-over artists, creators, writers, and dubbing artists (both internal and external) to produce engaging audio content.

3. Production Planning

Collaborate with content and production teams to plan episode pipelines, track weekly deliverables, and ensure timely completion of projects.

4. Stakeholder Collaboration

Coordinate with cross-functional teams including Content, Marketing, Product, and Quality teams to ensure alignment on production goals and timelines.

5. Production Quality Oversight

Work closely with the QC team to maintain high production standards, ensuring the final content meets quality benchmarks before launch.

6. Creator Network Management

description:

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

Estamos procurando um Representante Comercial – Soluções de Eletrodomésticos Comerciais para apoiar o desenvolvimento dos negócios da SolutionMall no Brasil.

Esta é uma função flexível, baseada em cooperação comercial, adequada para profissionais que possuam recursos locais de clientes, relacionamento com canais, distribuidores, integradores, empreiteiros ou experiência em desenvolvimento de negócios nos seguintes setores:

Esta não é uma função de venda no varejo de eletrodomésticos residenciais. Trata-se de uma função de desenvolvimento de negócios B2B , focada em equipamentos comerciais, projetos e aplicações de uso contínuo e profissional.

  • Coordenar a comunicação entre clientes, equipe da SolutionMall, fornecedores, distribuidores e contatos de projeto.

Esta função segue um modelo flexível de cooperação em desenvolvimento de negócios.

As principais áreas de atuação incluem:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Acompanhamento de RFQs e cotações
  • Comunicação sobre produtos e soluções
  • Desenvolvimento de canais

Para candidatos adequados, a SolutionMall poderá oferecer oportunidades de cooperação regional de longo prazo, com base em recursos de clientes verificados, progresso dos projetos e contribuição comercial real.

6) Benefícios da Cooperação

A SolutionMall oferece um modelo de cooperação vinculado ao desempenho e à contribuição comercial real, incluindo:

  • Desenvolvimento de clientes
  • Criação de oportunidades qualificadas
  • Avanço de RFQs
  • Desenvolvimento de canais
  • Progresso de projetos
  • Resultados de pedidos e negócios

Os termos detalhados de cooperação poderão ser discutidos durante o processo de entrevista, de acordo com a experiência do candidato, recursos de clientes, capacidade regional e contribuição para projetos.

7) Como se Candidatar

description:

We are looking for a Senior Business Analyst with strong experience in Financial Crimes and Process Engineering to support transformation initiatives within a global financial services environment.

This role requires a professional who can work closely with Compliance, Operations and Technology teams to map current processes, design future-state operating models, document requirements and support the implementation of improved, controlled and audit-ready processes.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with AML, KYC, Sanctions , process discovery, process mapping, AS-IS/TO-BE design, functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, controls documentation and UAT support.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead workshops with Compliance, Operations and Technology stakeholders.
  • Map AS-IS processes and design TO-BE processes with focus on efficiency, control and regulatory alignment.
  • Gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements.
  • Create user stories, acceptance criteria, process rules and data rules.
  • Support backlog prioritization and dependency management.
  • Define KPIs, success measures and process improvement opportunities.
  • Support the design of controls and evidence required for audit and regulatory purposes.
  • Partner with data and technology teams to ensure data quality and accurate system integrations.
  • Support UAT, functional validation and go-live readiness.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, including process flows, SOPs, RACI and data lineage.
  • Facilitate alignment and decision-making between business and technology teams.

Required experience

  • 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst .
  • At least 2+ years of experience in Financial Crimes , such as:
  • AML
  • KYC
  • Sanctions
  • Transaction monitoring
  • Compliance operations
  • Experience with process engineering , process discovery and process optimization.
  • Hands-on experience mapping AS-IS and TO-BE processes .
  • Experience with BPMN or similar process modeling notation.
  • Ability to write clear functional requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Familiarity with controls, risk management, regulatory expectations and audit-ready documentation.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across Compliance, Operations and Technology.
  • Experience supporting UAT, testing and go-live readiness.
  • Experience with Agile delivery and tools such as Azure DevOps, TFS, Jira or Confluence.
  • Advanced English for interaction with global teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience in financial services, banking, wealth management or consulting.
  • Six Sigma, Lean or process improvement certification.
  • Knowledge of data lineage, data quality and control frameworks.
  • Experience creating SOPs, RACI matrices and operational procedures.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt knowledge or certification.

Ideal profile

The ideal candidate is a Business Analyst with strong process improvement experience and real exposure to Financial Crimes . This is not a purely technical BA role and not a generic process analyst position. We are looking for someone who understands AML/KYC/Sanctions processes, can lead workshops, document requirements, map AS-IS/TO-BE processes, support UAT and help create controlled, audit-ready documentation.
