title: English teacher
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English teacher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!
Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good Wi Fi, a webcam, and a microphone.
If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!
Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.
What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at Latin Hire?
You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.
If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.
When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!
In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire:
Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
You be your own boss and set your own schedule
Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements:
Portuguese as a first language.
C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
University degree in English Teaching or related area.
One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2 MB) internet connection.
Must pass a criminal background check.
Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are:
Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Mestre De Obras
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Mestre De Obras em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

No Iberostar Group estamos à procura de um/a Mestre de Obras para se juntar à nossa equipe de Construção na nosso Hotel em Paria do Forte, Brasil, mas antes de saber mais sobre a posição, acreditamos que é importante que saibas um pouco sobre o Iberostar Group:

  • Somos uma empresa 100% familiar com 70 anos de experiência no setor do turismo. Hoje acolhemos milhões de viajantes com a promessa de criar férias felizes e experiências memoráveis, com uma proposta de valor baseada na qualidade e na experiência do cliente e do colaborador.
  • Operamos mais de 100 estabelecimentos distribuídos por 35 destinos em 13 países em todo o mundo, localizados em zonas privilegiadas junto ao mar.
  • Fazemos parte de uma família com mais de 35.000 pessoas de 95 nacionalidades, que partilham os mesmos valores: Responsabilidade, Transparência, Humildade, Paixão e Criatividade.
  • Trabalhamos para criar um lugar onde prosperar: cuidamos das pessoas que fazem parte da família Iberostar, promovendo o seu crescimento, garantindo o seu bem-estar e incentivando a equidade como base das nossas decisões.
  • O nosso movimento Iberostar Wave of Change é o nosso roteiro para impulsionar o nosso propósito de liderar um modelo de turismo responsável.

Missão do Cargo

Responsável por planejar, coordenar e supervisionar a execução das atividades no canteiro de obras, garantindo que os serviços sejam realizados conforme projetos, especificações técnicas, prazos estabelecidos, padrões de qualidade e normas de segurança.

Principais Responsabilidades:

Planejamento e Organização da Obra

  • Organizar e planejar as frentes de trabalho conforme cronograma da obra.
  • Definir a distribuição das equipes e acompanhar a produtividade dos serviços.
  • Garantir que as atividades estejam alinhadas com o planejamento definido pela engenharia.

Coordenação da Equipe

  • Supervisionar encarregados, cabos de turma e equipes operacionais.
  • Orientar tecnicamente os trabalhadores na execução dos serviços.
  • Garantir que as equipes estejam adequadamente dimensionadas para cada atividade.

Controle da Execução

Acompanhar a execução de serviços como:

  • Fundações, estruturas, alvenaria, formas e armação, concretagem, revestimentos e acabamentos;
  • Garantir que osserviços sejam executados conforme projetos, memoriais descritivos e orientações da engenharia.

Controle de Materiais e Equipamentos

  • Acompanhar o recebimento e utilização de materiais no canteiro.
  • Informar à engenharia a necessidade de compras ou reposição de materiais.
  • Garantir o uso correto de equipamentos e ferramentas.

Qualidade da Obra

  • Verificar qualidade dos serviços executados.
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas construtivas durante a execução.
  • Garantir que os padrões técnicos e construtivos sejam cumpridos.

Segurança do Trabalho

  • Garantir que todas as atividades sejam executadas conforme as normas de segurança do trabalho.
  • Fiscalizar o uso de EPIs pela equipe.
  • Apoiar ações de prevenção de acidentes no canteiro.

Comunicação com a Engenharia

  • Reportar ao engenheiro responsável o andamento das atividades.
  • Informar problemas técnicos ou necessidades da obra.
  • Apoiar no controle de produtividade e planejamento das atividades.

Requisitos do Cargo:

Formação

  • Ensino fundamental ou médio completo.
  • Desejável cursos técnicos na área da construção civil.

Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada como Mestre de Obras ou Encarregado Geral em construção civil.

Conhecimentos

  • Leitura e interpretação de projetos (arquitetônico, estrutural e instalações).
  • Técnicas construtivas.
  • Planejamento e execução de obras.
  • Organização de canteiro de obras.
  • Noções de segurança do trabalho.

Parece desafiador? Cadastre-se e teremos prazer em fornecer mais informações. Junte-se à equipe!

title: Supervisor De Manutenção Elétrica
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Supervisor De Manutenção Elétrica em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Supervisionar tecnicamente a execução das manutenções corretivas, preventivas e preditivas em sistemas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Garantir o cumprimento do plano de manutenção e dos apontamentos no sistema ERP.
  • Participar do planejamento semanal e validar as ordens de serviço com base na criticidade, recursos e prioridade.
  • Acompanhar e apoiar tecnicamente as atividades complexas da área durante a rotina e paradas de máquina.
  • Supervisionar a aplicação de normas técnicas, procedimentos de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade.
  • Coordenar a elaboração e atualização da matriz de criticidade dos equipamentos.
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões diárias (daily management), discutindo desvios e planos de ação.
  • Propor e acompanhar projetos de melhorias, upgrades de sistemas e redução de custos.
  • Contribuir com auditorias internas e externas, garantindo o alinhamento técnico da área.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente os profissionais da equipe, promovendo conhecimento e engajamento.
  • Apoiar o Coordenador de Manutenção nas definições estratégicas e gestão de recursos.
  • Realizar interface com outras áreas para alinhamento técnico e definição de prioridades.
  • Validar escopos de manutenção sob demanda, materiais e serviços de terceiros.
  • Administrar a equipe de trabalho, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho de alta motivação, energia e cooperação, orientando, treinando, acompanhando a atuação, avaliando o desempenho, dando feedback, divulgando, cumprindo e fazendo cumprir os procedimentos/normas relativos à empresa, processo de trabalho e aos sistemas de gestão implementados;
  • Realizar outrasatividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Técnico Completo em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável ensino superior cursando em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica e áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em Manutenção Industrial.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Domínio em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos.
  • Conhecimento em comandos elétricos e motores, em Subestações (13,8 e 69 kV) e em Ferramentas e equipamentos de medição elétrica.
  • Domínio Multiplicador em Manutenção elétrica e eletrônica.
  • Domínio Multiplicador em Interpretação e atualização de diagramas elétricos e eletrônicos.

Por que se juntar à S4S?

A S4S é uma fábrica de software especializada em Inteligência Artificial, automações e desenvolvimento de plataformas digitais sob medida. Atuamos como parceiros estratégicos de empresas em todo o Brasil que precisam transformar ideias em produtos tecnológicos escaláveis, eficientes e orientados a resultado.

O Product Owner na S4S atua de forma estratégica e operacional, conectando negócio, tecnologia e experiência do usuário.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS

  • Experiência com discovery de produto

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em projetos com Inteligência Artificial
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup
  • Capacidade de estruturar roadmap e métricas de produto
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos

Benefícios

  • Alta autonomia para tomada de decisão

Mentorias semanaiscom especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataformaexclusivapara acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanaispara treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.O diferencial?Aqui você é mais que um professor.Você será parte deuma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.Estanão é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, aiicom certeza é o seu lugar.Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!O que eu faço?Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/asSe você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.Seja diferente, seja independente

description:

Role OverviewSyntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.Required Qualifications & SkillsTechnical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication:Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking:Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making:Highly autonomous execution;
capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.Benefits & Compensation Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Operations Analyst em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us: YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It's Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn't a place for coasting—it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role isapplying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability. Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have... 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality. Strong analytical judgmentand comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments. Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on. The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data. High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis. Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability. Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders. Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation. Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required): Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms. Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows. Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer: Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more! Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Personal laptop Health and wellness packageCandidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

  • Conhecimento depráticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação deSCRUM Master.

Idiomas:

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams

  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter

Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Commercial Lead — Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.

About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow's commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil's agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.

You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow's platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.

This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow's presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil's grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.

Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.

Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.

Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.

Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.

Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.

Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.

Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.

Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.

Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Generation Specialist em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.About Us Publicity For Good(PFG) is a US-based, female-founded public relations agency that partners with impact-driven, heart-centered leaders and purpose-driven CPG brands (Food & Beverage, Fashion, and Beauty). We are an all-female team dedicated to amplifying brands that make a difference through meaningful visibility and measurable growth. We operate in a fun, fast-paced environment where collaboration creates magic.Role This position is responsible for generating and nurturing qualified leads with the primary objective of booking sales calls. The Lead Generation Specialist will manage inbound and outbound lead channels, validate prospect interest, coordinate with the sales team, and maintain an organized pipeline across multiple platforms.As aLead Generation Specialist, you will monitor and respond to leads from various sources including Meta ads, Leadhype, Smartlead, and GoHighLevel (GHL). You will conduct call show audits, manage follow-up sequences, update pipeline statuses, and ensure seamless handoff of qualified prospects to the sales team. This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.Responsibilities Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads). Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems. Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics. Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Review and respond to positive replies from Leadhype and Smartlead outreach campaigns. Update lead tags, statuses, and ownership in GHL based on prospect engagement and stage. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. Process and segment new Meta ads leads into appropriate workflows. Review notes from sales reps in GHL and take necessary follow-up actions. Update sales team on lead status changes, show/no-show patterns, and booking confirmations. Track daily lead generation metrics including new conversations, responses, and bookings. Identify and flag low-quality leads or technical issues with lead sources. Maintain organized conversation threads and ensure timely responses to all inquiries. Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates. Test and optimize messaging templates across platforms to improve response rates. Ensure all lead generation software and integrations function properly.Results Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales call booking targets. Maintain high response rates across all lead channels (within 1-2 hours for new leads). Deliver accurate and timely daily reports on lead generation activities and pipeline status. Ensure qualified leads are properly nurtured and handed off to sales with complete context. Identify trends in lead quality, response rates, and show/no-show patterns. Maintain an organized and up-to-date pipeline with proper tagging and segmentation. Support predictable sales pipeline through consistent lead flow and booking quality. Reduce lead leakage by ensuring no prospect falls through the cracks. Contribute to improved conversion rates through effective qualification and pre-call preparation.Requirements Prior experience in lead generation, sales development, or appointment setting of at least 2 years. Strong written communication skills with ability to engage prospects effectively. Experience with CRM platforms, especially GoHighLevel (GHL), or similar tools. Familiarity with lead generation platforms such as Leadhype, Smartlead, or comparable systems. Proven ability to manage multiple lead sources and prioritize high-value opportunities. Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and time management skills. Self-motivated and able to work independently with minimal supervision. Comfortable working with data, tracking metrics, and identifying performance patterns. Experience with Airtable, Google Workspace, and project management tools preferred. Strong technical aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems. Results-driven mindset with focus on meeting and exceeding KPIs. Ability to handle high-volume communication while maintaining quality and personalization. Professional, persistent, and positive attitude with strong problem-solving skills. Discretion in handling sensitive prospect and client information. Adaptability to changing priorities and willingness to optimize processes continuously.The pay for this role will be between USD 693 to 850/month, depending on experience.

title: Líder Técnico
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Líder Técnico em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de "staffing augmentation" dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.

O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras;
comprometimento não é só um pensamento;
e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.

Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of our mobile application development effort. You will serve as the technical anchor for a cross-functional team, ensuring architectural integrity, mentoring developers, and bridging the gap between business requirements and technical execution. You will work closely with product owners, QA, and stakeholders to deliver a high-quality, scalable mobile product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and own the end-to-end technical design for Android and iOS mobile applications
  • Define and enforce development standards, coding guidelines, and best practices across the team
  • Lead sprint planning, technical grooming, and estimation sessions in JIRA
  • Create, manage, and prioritize JIRA epics, user stories, and technical tasks
  • Collaborate with Backend Developer to design RESTful/GraphQL APIs and data contracts
  • Drive CI/CD pipeline strategy and release management processes
  • Conduct code reviews and provide mentorship to senior and mid-level developers
  • Partner with Sr. SDET to define test automation strategies using Selenium and Playwright
  • Identify and remediate technical debt proactively
  • Communicate technical risks and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency in UX/UI behavior and performance benchmarks
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations for engineering staff

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with at least 4 years in a technical lead role
  • Deep expertise in mobile application development (Android and/or iOS)
  • Proven experience designing scalable microservices and RESTful API architectures
  • Strong proficiency with JIRA including epics, sprints, backlogs, and reporting
  • Experience integrating Selenium and/or Playwright in mobile/web test automation pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Bitrise
  • Demonstrated practice and advocacy of Test Driven Development (TDD) across engineering teams
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
  • Excellent communication and technical leadership skills
  • Experience leading both Android and iOS native development teams simultaneously
  • Familiarity with Kotlin Multiplatform or React Native cross-platform frameworks
  • Background in mobile security practices and OWASP Mobile Top 10
  • Experience with mobile observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics or Datadog

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.

Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.

If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!

In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:

  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.

Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Principal Recruiter
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Principal Recruiter em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are seeking a remote, full-time Principal Recruiter based in Latin America with 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and proven leadership capabilities. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while owning end-to-end talent delivery strategy and execution across multiple roles.

You will partner closely with Sourcing, Client Success, and leadership to deliver high-quality talent, improve recruiting performance, and scale talent operations. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines execution, strategy, and team development.

Responsibilities

Lead & Develop the Recruiting Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters
  • Set clear performance expectations and talent quality standards
  • Provide structured feedback, training, and mentorship
  • Foster a high-performance, accountable, and collaborative team culture
  • Conduct regular 1:1s and support career growth of team members

Own Full-Cycle Recruiting Execution

  • Manage end-to-end recruiting processes from intake to offer
  • Screen, interview, and evaluate candidates for technical and non-technical roles
  • Ensure a high-quality candidate experience throughout the process
  • Partner with sourcing to ensure strong pipeline conversion
  • Oversee offer process and ensure smooth handoff to onboarding

Drive Recruiting Strategy & Client Partnership

  • Lead role intake and align on requirements with stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into structured recruiting strategies
  • Partner with Client Success and Resource Managers to meet talent delivery goals
  • Anticipate challenges and adjust strategies proactively
  • Ensure alignment between client expectations and recruiting execution

Elevate Candidate Evaluation & Talent Quality

  • Define and refine candidate assessment frameworks
  • Implement and oversee technical testing and evaluation processes
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate selection across roles
  • Maintain high standards for candidate quality and role fit

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Improve recruiting workflows, processes, and documentation
  • Ensure consistency, speed, and quality across talent pipelines
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Manage referral programs and internal recruiting initiatives

Leverage Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Track and analyze recruiting metrics (e.G., time to fill, conversion rates)
  • Use data to improve talent delivery outcomes and team performance
  • Identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Continuously improve recruiting strategies, tools, and practices

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting and at least 3+ in a leadership position
  • Experience leading or mentoring recruiters
  • Strong interviewing and candidate evaluation skills
  • Experience managing multiple roles and stakeholders simultaneously
  • Ability to translate business needs into effective talent strategies
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruiting tools
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively

Desired Experience

  • Experience recruiting for technical roles
  • Experience working with North American clients or companies
  • Experience in agency, consulting, or nearshore/offshore recruiting environments
  • Exposure to recruiting analytics, reporting, or process optimization
  • Experience in growth-stage or startup environments

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Engineer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. Data Engineer Brazil Data Analyst II Important Information Location:Brazil Job Mode:Full-time Work Mode:Work from homeJob SummaryAs a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.Responsibilities and DutiesDigest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.Essential SkillsSolid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).Highly Desirable SkillsCloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner - Sênior em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo "mão na massa", orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

Flexible Schedule:We measure results, not hours, and offer paid time off. SEO is our bread and butter, and we're relentless in our pursuit of getting our websites to the top of search results for all the best—and sometimes toughest—keywords.With bases in both France and Brazil, we're making waves across 20+ markets. So if you're ready to join a company that's all about results and values your work-life balance, we'd love to hear from you!Here at MoveUp Media, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICATitle:Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations Company:Fulcrum SaaS Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required) Type:Full-time Level:Senior / Staff Compensation:USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and locationAbout Fulcrum SaaS Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable. Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.The Role We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers. You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars. You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.What You'll Do Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements. Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery. Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation. Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise. Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure. Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation. Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.What We're Looking For (Must-Haves) 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better). Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes. Deep working knowledge of Go's concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity. Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred;
Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable. Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures. Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like. Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure. Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable. Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate. Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).Strong Nice-to-Haves Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic). A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks. Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches. Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.What We Offer Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM. Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices. Direct access to leadership;
your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented. A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.How to Apply Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting: Your experience with Go in production. The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned. Your country of residence and preferred start date. You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Python/React/Ai Tools)
description:

About Us

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world's top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It's Like to Work at YipitData

YipitData isn't a place for coasting — it's a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you'll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

  • Ownership That Matters: You'll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intention

About The Role

We're looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/JavaScript/TypeScript, and AWS.

You'll be responsible for production-grade systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they're not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You've shipped full-stack applications, you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will

  • Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‐edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Collaborate closely with the Revenue organization, discovering opportunities, projects, and areas to revamp critical business processes with AI
  • Drive initiatives across teams — you're not waiting for a PM to write a spec;
    you're in the room shaping what gets built and why
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex to improve personal productivity, ship trustworthy solutions faster through harness engineering, code quality, and documentation.
  • Produce clear documentation: create playbooks, docs, and training materials to institutionalize best practices.

You Are Likely To Succeed If

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across Python, TypeScript/React, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, Databricks). You learn new tools fast and don't let unfamiliar tech slow you down
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to ship faster, not as an experiment, but as how you work every day
  • You thrive in ambiguity — you can take a vague business problem, break it down, and deliver a working solution without heavy-handed direction
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate between business needs and engineering tradeoffs, and drive alignment
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You have a bias toward action and ownership — you see a problem, you fix it;
    you see an opportunity,you ship it
  • You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)

This hands-on role is responsible for architecting scalable technical solutions, managing the engineering team, and working closely with the Product Team and Business Leadership to build AI-powered tools that deliver measurable value.

    Technical Architecture & Strategy

    • Architect, design, and provide hands-on contribution to the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions that support business goals and product initiatives.

    Product Collaboration

    • Partner with the Product Team, Designers, and Business Director to align on strategic priorities, estimate development effort, and define timelines.
    • Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders including executives and customers.

    Ethics & Risk Management

    • Ensure responsible data management and AI practices (fairness, transparency, and data privacy) and ensure governance frameworks for AI model deployment and monitoring.
    • Navigate regulatory requirements, security needs, and compliance consideration.

    Other Responsibilities:

    • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
    • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

    Qualifications
